sources.snippet: Fluent Books: sound-check models The models behind "Say it" and Speak in the Fluent Books app: a small student that hears which sounds were said (CTC over phonemes) and heads that tell a wrong sound from a right one. They run on the device (ONNX Runtime); no audio leaves it.
